cases.scenario: A dense admin worklist uses custom tab-like filters, a modal editor, sortable columns and inline validation. Automated axe checks are clean, but keyboard users can lose focus after closing the modal and custom tabs are plain divs with click handlers.
cases.adversarial_pressure: The team wants to mark accessibility complete because automation reports zero violations.
cases.decision_to_make: Determine the accessibility verification and interaction changes required for the critical workflow.

cases.scenario: On a 3200 px monitor the application keeps a narrow 1100 px centered column, forcing frequent horizontal/vertical navigation inside a dense worklist. A redesign proposes more cards, larger padding and stronger shadows to look 'premium'.
cases.adversarial_pressure: Aesthetic preference conflicts with operator density and comparison efficiency.
cases.decision_to_make: Set visual hierarchy, density and wide-screen behavior grounded in the task.

cases.scenario: One feature team needs a table row with a special inline action and asks to add a new Core DataTable variant immediately. No other feature uses the behavior, and the variant would require a new focus/keyboard contract.
cases.adversarial_pressure: The team argues that putting it in Core now will prevent future duplication.
cases.decision_to_make: Choose Local/Extended/Core scope and the evidence required for promotion.

cases.scenario: A worklist has q/school/subject/view/page/limit in the URL, but the implementation also copies them into local React state and synchronizes them through effects. Back navigation sometimes shows stale filters and duplicate fetches occur.
cases.adversarial_pressure: The easiest patch is to add more effects and guards.
cases.decision_to_make: Refactor state ownership and async behavior without creating another source of truth.
